commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge ({1}{U}{B}{R} 1/3 flying legendary Vampire Wizard; Commander 2013, set c13, released 2013-11-01; commander-legal, not a Game Changer, no project exception). ETB: each player exiles the top X cards of their library, X = mana spent to cast her (commander tax raises X). Attack: you may cast an instant or sorcery from among cards exiled with her without paying its mana cost. Plan (owner blueprint 2026-10-14): stage a high-impact spell on top (Mystical, Vampiric, Imperial Seal, Personal Tutor, Scheming Symmetry, Long-Term Plans, Brainstorm, Scroll Rack, Sensei's Divining Top), cast Jeleva, give haste (Torch Courier, Lightning Greaves, Arena of Glory, or Borne Upon a Wind end-step flash), attack and cast it free (Mind's Desire, Peer into the Abyss, Mnemonic Betrayal, Doomsday, Yawgmoth's Will, Final Fortune). Harmonic Prodigy doubles both triggers. Backups: Thassa's Oracle + Demonic Consultation / Tainted Pact / Doomsday and Underworld Breach + Lion's Eye Diamond + Brain Freeze / Wheel of Fortune / Jeska's Will.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 5 (fringe cEDH; owner-approved), unchanged. Game Changers: 20 in both baseline and candidate (Ad Nauseam, Ancient Tomb, Chrome Mox, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Force of Will, Gamble, Grim Monolith, Imperial Seal, Jeska's Will, Lion's Eye Diamond, Mana Vault, Mox Diamond, Mystical Tutor, Necropotence, Opposition Agent, Rhystic Study, Thassa's Oracle, Underworld Breach, Vampiric Tutor). The owner's decisions file records 2026 EDHTop16 Jeleva entries (best 18th of 103) and 0% large-event conversion.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Jeleva's Oracle: no generic Grixis staple is added. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the Grixis cEDH cores, baseline = candidate, canonical Archidekt exports): Kess, Dissident Mage 78; Kefka, Court Mage 77; Inalla, Archmage Ritualist 68; Evelyn, the Covetous 67. The overlap is the cEDH staple core (fast mana, tutors, free counters, Oracle/Breach). Jeleva-unique against all four: Doomsday, Lightning Greaves, Long-Term Plans, Mind's Desire, Peer into the Abyss, Preordain, Scheming Symmetry, Scroll Rack, Sensei's Divining Top, Torch Courier, Yawgmoth's Will. Every rejected generic add (Dramatic Reversal + Isochron Scepter, Reanimate, Intuition) would raise that overlap. Owner-removed or rejected cards and classes (Mana Drain, Cyclonic Rift, Mizzix's Mastery, Time Stretch, Nexus of Fate, Swiftfoot Boots, Frantic Search, signets, Mountain, The One Ring, Beseech the Mirror, Praetor's Grasp, Notion Thief, Dauthi Voidwalker, Orcish Bowmasters, Valley Floodcaller, Roaming Throne, Strionic Resonator, Burnt Offering, Rain of Filth) are not re-added.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge general absent, upgraded absent, optimized absent, cEDH 4/30 (synergy 0.117); live Scryfall batch; Pass C's first requested test (sealed Stage A verdict NEEDS TESTING +Intuition/-Long-Term Plans)
material_candidates.role: {2}{U} instant: reveal three cards; target opponent puts one into your hand and the rest into your graveyard (Game Changer).
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Long-Term Plans is an owner explicit keep ('RETAINED over Mana Drain', 2026-10-14 adversarial second pass): {2}{U} instant tutor to third from top, which Jeleva's ETB (X>=4 on any normal cast) captures immediately. It is one of 11 Jeleva stagers (bounded T1). Absent from the 30-deck cEDH sample. Alternative cut: Scheming Symmetry is an owner addition named in the commander blueprint ('unusually strong here'): {B} sorcery; two different target players (CR 115.3) each tutor to the top, and Jeleva's ETB can exile both staged cards. cEDH 5/30.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: None for Jeleva's top-stage job: Intuition never puts a card into the library, so nothing it finds can be exiled with Jeleva (CR 607.2a). It feeds graveyard lines (Underworld Breach, Yawgmoth's Will).
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Bounded T2, exhaustive hostile-choice enumeration: the Breach/LED/Brain Freeze pile fails (the opponent hands over LED or Brain Freeze and strands Breach in the graveyard). The Oracle/Consultation/Pact pile hands over the dead piece. The triple-tutor pile is a slower stager. Cutting Long-Term Plans drops direct stagers 11 -> 10 (P(>=1 stager) by 8 cards 0.6246 -> 0.5875). It cuts an owner explicit keep (or, with the alternative cut, the {B} blueprint stager Scheming Symmetry; both staged as complete 100s). It adds a 21st Game Changer. Spellbook 7 -> 7 for both.
material_candidates.reason: Measured worse at the commander's job and cuts an owner explicit keep; the GrokBot 'waits two draws' premise is false (T1 rules).

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Data-led two-card combo (cEDH 11/30 and 8/30), staged as a complete 100. Spellbook 7 -> 8 (4821-5261). REJECTED: generic Grixis infinite with no Jeleva text, cuts an owner explicit keep and a blueprint stager.

low_swap_heightened_audit.no_two_package_reason: Only one credible multi-slot package exists: Dramatic Reversal + Isochron Scepter, the one pair of non-incumbents whose value depends on each other (Spellbook 4821-5261). Every other admissible candidate works alone, and its single-slot test already settles it. Combining rejected singles (for example Intuition + Galvanic Iteration over Long-Term Plans + Borne Upon a Wind, or Snap + Spellseeker over Gitaxian Probe + Mental Misstep) adds no interaction. The measured losses simply add up: fewer stagers, fewer haste/flash enablers, slower protection. So no second package is credible.
low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C requested +Intuition against Long-Term Plans and against Scheming Symmetry, and +Galvanic Iteration against Borne Upon a Wind. All three are staged as complete 100s and measured (T1-T3). Alternate cuts outside the owner keep list were checked (Gitaxian Probe, Mental Misstep, Exotic Orchard, Arena of Glory, Personal Tutor); every incumbent is owner-directed (retained 37 or added 62), so no non-owner-directed cut exists.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Scroll Rack (2/30), Scheming Symmetry (5/30), Arena of Glory (5/30) and Personal Tutor (6/30) are the lowest-data incumbents, while Snap, Dramatic Reversal and Reanimate each sit at 11/30 in the cEDH sample.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Zero genuine admissible swaps. The low-data incumbents are Jeleva-specific stagers and haste pieces named in the owner blueprint; the high-data challengers are generic (Dramatic Reversal + Isochron Scepter, Reanimate) or do not clearly beat their slot (Snap over Gitaxian Probe, staged as an owner decision). The Pass C tests (Intuition, Galvanic Iteration) measured worse on Jeleva's own job.
